story.titleZh: 博尔托莱托vs霍肯伯格：2026赛季F1队友半程对决评分
story.summaryZh: 尽管积分榜差距看似悬殊，但尼科·霍肯伯格和加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托实际上是2026赛季赛道上实力最接近的队友组合，霍肯伯格的不走运掩盖了两人之间的均势。

story.originalTitle: Bortoleto vs Hulkenberg: 2026 F1 team mates’ head-to-head scores at summer break
story.summaryEn: Although the points gap may suggest a one-sided battle, Nico Hulkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto are actually the most evenly matched team mate pairing on the track in 2026, with Hulkenberg's bad luck masking how close they are.
detailZh: 尽管2025年是尼科·霍肯伯格终于首次登上领奖台的赛季，但他最新的这个赛季看起来令人担忧地可能成为他第一个没有积分的赛季。
他在匈牙利站纠正了这一点，将他的奥迪赛车带回第九名，获得了迟来的两分。由于队友加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托已经有10分在手，奥迪车手们因拥有迄今为止最不具代表性的积分而显得突出：他们在下面所有三项其他指标上几乎持平。
如何将他们区分开来？可以肯定地说，霍肯伯格在可靠性方面运气更差。尽管每位车手在开局两轮中都登记了一次未发车，但自那以后霍肯伯格遇到了更多麻烦，包括在西班牙站一次几乎滑稽的不走运退赛，当时一块飞溅的碎石不知怎么击中了一个开关，瞬间使他的R26赛车失灵。
博尔托莱托在澳大利亚站以自己获得的第九名开启了积分账户，这在此后七轮中一直是奥迪唯一的积分。他在接下来的几轮中凭借两次第八名达到两位数，并且随着奥迪改进赛车，他一直稳定地处于积分争夺中：他在最近六轮中的另外四次成绩均为第11名。
因此，霍肯伯格的糟糕运气是唯一掩盖了2026年迄今为止赛道上看起来最势均力敌的队友组合的因素。鉴于两人之间经验上的巨大差距，这对博尔托莱托来说是一个强有力的肯定，他肯定会在赛季后半段寻求与队友拉开一些差距。
不具代表性的比较已省略。负值：博尔托莱托更快；正值：霍肯伯格更快
detailEn: While 2025 was the season in which Nico Hulkenberg finally scored his first podium, his latest campaign looked worryingly like becoming his first without a point.

He put that right in Hungary, bringing his Audi home in ninth place for an overdue two points. With team mate Gabriel Bortoleto already on 10, the Audi drivers stand out for having by far the least representative scores: they are practically level on all three other metrics below.

How to pull them apart? It is certainly fair to say Hulkenberg has had worse luck in terms of unreliability. Although each driver registered one non-start over the opening two rounds, since then Hulkenberg has had more trouble, including an almost comically unlucky retirement in Spain where a piece of flying gravel somehow struck a switch which instantly disabled his R26.

Bortoleto opened his account with a ninth place of his own in Australia, which remained Audi’s only points for the next seven rounds. He reached double-digits thanks to a pair of eighth-place finishes in the next rounds and has been consistently in the hunt for points as Audi has improved its car: his four other results in the last six rounds were all in 11th place.

Hulkenberg’s poor luck is therefore the only thing disguising what otherwise looks like the most evenly-matched pairing on the grid in 2026 so far. Given the gulf in experience between the two, that is a strong endorsement of Bortoleto, who will surely be looking to put some daylight between himself and his team mate in the second half of the season.
Unrepresentative comparisons omitted. Negative value: Bortoleto was faster; Positive value: Hulkenberg was faster

博尔托莱托在澳大利亚站以第九名首次得分，随后两度获得第八名，最近六轮中另外四场均为第11名。
